scope: Actual deployed registrations, goal planner, step planner and global active-maker/passive-checker route. Browser explicitly approves each local effect. No autonomous workflow grant or backend knowledge seeding.

steps.title: Fill Customer Form
steps.instruction: Fill the demo-form with Company name as 'Goal UAT 1792434246335', Contact email as 'goal.uat@example.test', and Region as 'Singapore'.
steps.expected: The form should display the entered values correctly.

steps.title: Save Customer
steps.expected: The customer should be saved successfully.

steps.title: Open Note Section
steps.expected: The Note page should be displayed.

steps.title: Fill Note
steps.instruction: Set Title to 'Followup Goal UAT 1792434246335' and Body to 'Follow up with Goal UAT 1792434246335 about their renewal'.
steps.expected: The note should display the entered title and body correctly.

steps.title: Save Note
steps.expected: The note should be saved successfully.

steps.title: Open Opportunity Section
steps.expected: The Opportunity page should be displayed.

steps.title: Fill Opportunity
steps.instruction: Set Opportunity name to 'Renewal Goal UAT 1792434246335', Amount to '12500', and Currency to 'USD'.
steps.expected: The opportunity should display the entered values correctly.

steps.title: Save Opportunity
steps.expected: The opportunity should be saved successfully.

steps.title: Fill customer details
steps.instruction: Fill the form with Company name as 'Clarify Goal 1792434284147', Contact email as 'clarification.uat@example.test', and Region as 'Singapore'.
steps.expected: The form should display the filled values correctly.

steps.title: Save customer record
steps.instruction: Use the visible Save control to save the customer record.
steps.expected: The customer record should be saved successfully.
